source.note: Peak (3-5 min) / off-peak (7-10 min) headway bands cited from UITP CityTransit Tehran data; this file uses 4 min peak (07:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00) and 8 min off-peak within those bands.

Per-segment travel times are ESTIMATES: computed from the great-circle distance between the 3 real station coordinates already bundled in tehran.json and a typical ~32 km/h average heavy-rail metro operating speed (includes dwell), not an official minute-by-minute feed. Each segment here actually spans several real, not-yet-bundled intermediate Line 1 stations, so real single-stop times would be shorter and more numerous. First/last train times (05:30/22:30) match the existing operatingHours in tehran.json. Re-verify against an official GTFS feed when one becomes available.
